summary: Multi-provider review identified defects requiring correction (10 findings).

individualReviews.summary: While the execution exited with code 0 and reported 47 passing test executions, critical verification gaps remain: no explicit test command or Docker 512 MB peak RSS telemetry was captured, and the canonical SHA-256 hash was truncated in stdout.

findings.description: Test Command and Test Output are recorded as 'None' / 'No testCommand specified', leaving the exact pytest invocation and per-suite pass breakdown (e.g., test_pure_onnx_runtime.py and test_candidate_b_production_regression.py) unverified.
findings.recommendedAction: Provide the explicit test command executed (e.g., pytest invocation covering all target test files) and capture full test runner output.

findings.description: Peak container memory usage under the $0 Render 512 MB limit (via scripts/benchmark_docker_container_512m.py) is absent from Standard Output Tail, despite zero-swap enforcement (memory.swap.max = 0) being reported.
findings.recommendedAction: Run scripts/benchmark_docker_container_512m.py and include the measured peak RSS / memory ceiling telemetry under 512 MB cgroup v2 limits in the execution output.

findings.description: Canonical surgical embedding SHA-256 is truncated to 'BAB77026...' in stdout rather than logging the full 64-character digest (BAB7702658BB5C87248B991659D987150A280BC944C2E50863786E0098A01BD1), and dual-corpus Candidate B (92224DC6...) / Candidate C Lite (9A8B7A1D...) artifact hashes are not explicitly printed.
findings.recommendedAction: Emit full non-truncated SHA-256 checksums for backend/app/data/dr_momenul_surgical_embeddings.npy, Candidate B, and Candidate C Lite in the reconciliation log.

findings.description: Changed Files lists 9 files (including untracked PHASE_2_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION_REPORT.md) whereas Git Diff Stat reports 8 files changed, indicating the reconciliation report was not staged or tracked in git diff.
findings.recommendedAction: Stage PHASE_2_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION_REPORT.md so git diff stat reflects all 9 modified/added artifacts.

evidenceReferences: Git Diff Stat: 8 files changed, 424 insertions(+), 44 deletions(-)
requiredCorrections: Specify and execute the explicit test command covering backend/tests/test_pure_onnx_runtime.py, backend/tests/test_query_understanding.py, and backend/tests/test_candidate_b_production_regression.py with full stdout capture.
Execute scripts/benchmark_docker_container_512m.py and attach actual peak memory usage (< 512 MB) alongside memory.swap.max = 0.
Output full 64-character SHA-256 hashes for the surgical embedding file and both dual-corpus candidate artifacts.
missingEvidence: Explicit test command invocation and verbose test runner output
Peak RSS / memory usage measurement in MB from scripts/benchmark_docker_container_512m.py
Full 64-character SHA-256 verification output for dr_momenul_surgical_embeddings.npy, Candidate B (92224DC6...), and Candidate C Lite (9A8B7A1D...)

individualReviews.summary: Execution reports exit 0 and 47 passing test executions, but none of the five declared target files appear in the changed-file set, and the key evidence claims (SHA-256, zero-swap, dual-corpus regression) are only asserted in a stdout tail rather than traceable to executed verification.

findings.description: None of the five declared Target Files (surgical_embeddings.npy, benchmark_docker_container_512m.py, test_pure_onnx_runtime.py, test_query_understanding.py, test_candidate_b_production_regression.py) are in the reported changed-files list. Only test_query_understanding.py is claimed untouched among the tests; the embedding artifact, benchmark harness, and ONNX/Candidate-B test files show no evidence of being exercised or modified.
findings.recommendedAction: Re-run the full evidence collection with an explicit testCommand that executes backend/tests/test_pure_onnx_runtime.py, backend/tests/test_query_understanding.py, and backend/tests/test_candidate_b_production_regression.py, and capture per-file pass/fail output. Include scripts/benchmark_docker_container_512m.py output in stdout tail.

findings.description: Test Command is 'None' with 'No testCommand specified', yet the stdout tail asserts '47 passed test executions'. The pass count is not attributable to a reproducible invocation, so the pass result cannot be independently verified.
findings.recommendedAction: Provide the exact pytest invocation (e.g., pytest backend/tests -q) and its machine-readable summary line so the 47/41 count is traceable.

findings.description: Canonical embedding SHA-256 BAB77026... is asserted in prose but no hash computation command or output is included. The .npy artifact is not in the changed files, so neither its presence nor its digest is verified.
findings.recommendedAction: Include `sha256sum backend/app/data/dr_momenul_surgical_embeddings.npy` output verbatim and confirm equality to BAB7702658BB5C87248B991659D987150A280BC944C2E50863786E0098A01BD1.

findings.description: Docker zero-swap claim (memory.swap.max = 0) and 512 MB memory peak are asserted without the benchmark script output, cgroup inspection output, or memory.stat evidence. The benchmark harness is not in the changed files and no captured run is shown.
findings.recommendedAction: Attach scripts/benchmark_docker_container_512m.py stdout, the `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/.../memory.swap.max` result, and memory.peak from the same container run.

findings.description: Candidate B (92224DC6...) and Candidate C Lite (9A8B7A1D...) preservation is an agreed decision, but no checksum or artifact verification for either candidate appears in the evidence, and the dual-corpus regression is only summarized in prose.
findings.recommendedAction: Add sha256 checks for both candidate artifacts and per-corpus regression counts (Candidate B vs Candidate C Lite) to prove the hybrid ensemble is intact.

findings.description: Changed files are primarily frontend/components and config/service code, plus a report markdown; these are consistent with an evidence-reconciliation change set but do not themselves constitute the runtime/embedding verification the task requires.
findings.recommendedAction: Confirm whether the code changes are in scope; if so, ensure regression coverage for config.py, api_models.py, retrieval_service.py, and query_understanding_service.py is included in the captured test run.

evidenceReferences: Diff Stat: 8 files changed, 424 insertions(+), 44 deletions(-)
Standard Output Tail: 47 passed, zero-swap, SHA-256 asserted
requiredCorrections: Provide a concrete testCommand and its full output rather than 'No testCommand specified'.
Show verbatim sha256sum output for dr_momenul_surgical_embeddings.npy matching BAB7702658BB5C87248B991659D987150A280BC944C2E50863786E0098A01BD1.
Attach Docker benchmark output proving memory.swap.max = 0 and the 512 MB peak, not just a prose claim.
Include per-artifact checks for Candidate B (92224DC6...) and Candidate C Lite (9A8B7A1D...) plus dual-corpus regression counts.
Reconcile the mismatch between declared Target Files and the reported Changed Files.
missingEvidence: Executable test command and machine-readable test summary
SHA-256 computation output for the surgical embeddings artifact
Docker cgroup memory.swap.max and memory.peak capture
Candidate B and Candidate C Lite artifact checksum verification
Per-corpus regression evidence for the hybrid dual-corpus ensemble
Evidence that the declared target test files were executed
